proof:
have hle : s.re ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  by_contra hc
  exact (hRight s (lt_of_not_ge hc)) hz
have hflip : L (1 - s) = 0 := hFlip s hs0 hs1 hz
have hleflip : (1 - s).re ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  by_contra hc
  exact (hRight (1 - s) (lt_of_not_ge hc)) hflip
have hge : 1 / 2 ≤ s.re := by
  have hreal : (1 - s).re = 1 - s.re := by simp
  linarith
exact le_antisymm hle hge

by_contra hc
have hpos : 0 < (r - 1 / 2) / 2 := by linarith
have hbound := h ((r - 1 / 2) / 2) hpos
linarith

have hB : 0 ≤ x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 6) * eps) :=
  Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _
have hterm : K * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + eps) ≤
    K * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 6) * eps) :=
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSmall hK
have hcomp : G ≤ (1 + K) * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 6) * eps) := by
  nlinarith
have hcoeff := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hErr hB
have hpow : x ^ eps * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 6) * eps) =
    x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 7) * eps) := by
  rw [← Real.rpow_add hx]
  congr 1
  ring
rw [hpow] at hcoeff
exact le_trans hcomp hcoeff

constructor
· intro h
  exact ⟨h.caraianiLocalGlobalDual, h.localLanglandsExists⟩
· rintro ⟨hrow, hrec⟩
  exact ⟨hrow, hrec, hrow⟩

rcases h with ⟨i, _, _, hw, hb⟩
exact ⟨i, hw, hb⟩

classical
have hsum : (∑ i, f i) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Err := by
  calc
    (∑ i, f i) ≤ ∑ _i : ι, Err := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact hpoint i
    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Err := by simp
have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by
  exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
rw [horth] at hsum
by_contra h
have hdiff : 0 < A - Err := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
have hprod : 0 < (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (A - Err) :=
  mul_pos hcard hdiff
nlinarith

have hn : 0 ≤ (TT.card : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) := by positivity
have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcost hn
calc
  local_sum ≤ base_sum + (TT.card : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) * K := hlocal
  _ ≤ base_sum + (TT.card : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) * (2 * b / x) :=
    add_le_add_left hmul base_sum
  _ = base_sum + 2 * (TT.card : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) * b / x := by ring

have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBracket
  (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le (C * eps))
have hexp : x ^ (C * eps) * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + eps) =
    x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (C + 1) * eps) := by
  rw [← Real.rpow_add hx]
  congr 1
  ring
exact hErr.trans (hp.trans_eq hexp)

have hp : 0 < x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - eps) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _
have hchain : x * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - eps) ≤
    (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - eps) := by
  calc
    x * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - eps) ≤ x * (m : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm hx.le
    _ ≤ k := hk_lower
    _ ≤ _ := hk_upper
by_contra h
have hdiff : 0 < x - (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
have hprod : 0 < (x - (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - eps) :=
  mul_pos hdiff hp
nlinarith

have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
have hpTT : 0 < x ^ (-(eps / 8)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _
have hTTleft : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ (-(eps / 8)) * (n : ℝ) / 2 :=
  div_pos (mul_pos hpTT hnreal) (by norm_num)
have hnTreal : (0 : ℝ) < (nT : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hTTleft hTT
have hpT2 : 0 < x ^ (-eps) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _
have hT2ineq : x ^ (-eps) * (n : ℝ) ≤ (nT2 : ℝ) :=
  (le_div_iff₀ hnreal).mp hT2
have hnT2real : (0 : ℝ) < (nT2 : ℝ) :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hpT2 hnreal) hT2ineq
have hmreal : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _) hm
exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hnTreal, by exact_mod_cast hnT2real,
  by exact_mod_cast hmreal⟩
